The ∩ shape is 3 wide, 3 tall: YYY/YcY/YcY. If you put a horizontal bar in the opening... hmm.
Actually, the C/U shape might be a "keyhole" pattern: the token needs to be rotated to match. The green token is horizontal (3x6), the green box's chambers are horizontal C shapes. The yellow token is vertical (9x3), the yellow box's chambers are vertical U/∩ shapes.
Maybe the game is: click a token to rotate it 90°, click a box to... no, that's not it.

Let me try a sequence: click the yellow token (31,10), then click the yellow box's chamber (38,24).
Actually, let me think about what "the token fits into the box" would look like: the yellow token is 9x3 (including the edge). The yellow box's interior is 11x5 (rows 36-46, columns 22-26). The green token is 3x6 (3 tall, 6 wide including the edge). The green box's interior is 5x11 (rows 19-23, columns 37-47). The token is 6 wide vs interior 11 — fits; 3 tall vs 5 — fits.
So the goal is probably to move each token into the box of the same color. The C/U shape inside the box is a "socket" that the token must align with.
How do you move? Maybe click the token to move it one step toward the box of the same color? Clicked the token twice — nothing happened.
Hmm, maybe the click has to be exactly on the red dot? Clicked (34,10) — the red dot. Nothing.
Maybe the movement is: click a cell adjacent to the token in the direction of the box. The yellow box is to the lower-right of the yellow token. Clicked (40,10) (below). Nothing.
Maybe I need to click the gray edge (the "handle") of the token. The yellow token's edge is at row 27 (top). The green token's edge is at column 27 (left). Let me try clicking (27,10).
Or, the game might require clicking two objects in sequence within a certain time window, and my actions are too slow? Unlikely.
Let me try: click the yellow token's gray edge (27,10), then click the yellow box (41,24) in the same batch. If the edge is a "drag handle," clicking the edge and then the destination might move it.
